$comment: The venv exists for the CLI, not for the library: models.resolve_endpoint() reads the layered config.yaml via bootstrap_lib.config_resolve, which requires PyYAML. The standalone Python the shims used to call carries only .pth links and no third-party packages, so every subcommand -- set-key included -- died on ModuleNotFoundError: yaml. bootstrap_lib is linked in because config_resolve lives there.
